newsitem.title: USA: American Western Refining files bankruptcy.
newsitem.headline: American Western Refining files bankruptcy.

text.p: American Western Refining LP on Wednesday filed for Chapter 11 protection in the U.S. Bankruptcy Court in Delaware.
Court papers did not list the company's assets or liabilities but do list its 20 largest unsecured creditors.
American Western is a petroleum refining company based in Lawrenceville, Illinois.
Most of the unsecured debt is trade debt including $2.5 million claimed by Custodis-Ecodyne. No other information about the bankruptcy is available at this time.
